violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: chili sauce and lemongrass sauce made on 9/12/2026 in 2DR Metalfrio Display Cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC date marked foods.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. CFM will order prior to follow up inspection.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: stove/oven, fryer, coolers, cooler gaskets.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Please clean prior to next routine inspection.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Repair per Law
violations.observation: A recent repair to plumbing system components of the prep sink was not done in accordance with law. A white box / interceptor was installed under the prep sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be repaired according to Law. Please correct within 3 days.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Odor is coming from the grease trap under the prep sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Please maintain the grease trap and keep maintenance records. PHO 102 RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 09/15/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the wall behind the meat slicer and floors under equipment are dirty.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Please clean prior to next routine inspection.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: PORK SPRING ROLLS AT 44-49F IN KELVINATOR 1 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. SEVERAL BOXES ON VERMICELLI STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN BACK STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS FOR FOOD STORAGE. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean

violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE THOROUGH CLEANING AND MAINTAIN AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE RINSING AND DRYING HANDS WITHOUT USING SOAP.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO PROPERLY REWASH HANDS WITH SOAP. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the END OF COOK LINE being used TO WASH NOODLE STRAINER.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO TRANSFER NOODLE STRAINER TO DISHWASHING MACHINE FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: MEAT SLICER OBSERVED WITH FOOD PARTICLES; SOILED UTENSILS OBSERVED HANGING ON RACK.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO CLEAN AND SANITIZE MEAT SLICER AND REMOVED UTENSILS FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: LEMON GRASS SAUCE AT 53F ON FRONT SERVICE COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control (TPHC) as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RETURNED LEMON GRASS TO REFRIGERATION UNIT DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE TCS FOODS ARE MAINTAINED UNDER TEMPERATURE CONTROL UNLESS USING TPHC PROCEDURES.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items: CLEANING CHEMICALS STORED WITH UTENSILS AND SINGLE ITEMS IN KITCHEN, BACK STORAGE AND FRONT SERVICE AREAS.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO RELOCATE CHEMICALS TO DESIGNATED STORAGE AREA DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name: SPRAY BOTTLES OF CLEANING CHEMICALS WITHOUT LABELS.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC APPLIED LABELS DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED PREPARED SHREDDED LETTUCE AT 74F FOR 2.5 HOURS IN TIGHTLY SEALED BAG IN 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR (RIGHT).
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO TRANSFER TO FREEZER AND MONITOR WITH THERMOMETER FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: OBSERVED KITCHEN BACK DOOR is kept open for ventilation and opening is not protected by AN EFFECTIVE screen or other effective means.
violations.corrective_action: Provide screens (16 mesh to 1 inch), air curtains, or other effective means to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO KEEP DOOR CLOSED TO PREVENT ENTRY TO PESTS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Safe Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not safe: LOWES AND HOME DEPOT BUCKETS USED TO STORE PREPARED VEGETABLES AND SAUCES IN 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR .
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE FOODS FROM BUCKETS AND TRANSFER TO NSF APPROVED FOOD SAFE CONTAINERS. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Hard Wood
violations.observation: Wood or wood wicker is used in contact with food. OBSERVED WOODEN STICK USED FOR STIRRING CHICKEN WHILE COOKING.
violations.corrective_action: Wood and wood wicker may not be used as a food-contact surface unless the wood is hard maple or close-grained and used for cutting boards, cutting blocks, bakers' tables, and utensils such as rolling pins, doughnut dowels, salad bowls, and chopsticks. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD STICK AND USE ONLY FOOD SAFE UTENSILS FOR STIRRING FOODS.

violations.corrective_action: Provide end caps to completely enclose the light bulb. PLEASE REPLACE LIGHT SHIELDS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: COOKED CHICKEN AT 112F FOR 1.5 HOURS ON COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT TO 165F AND RESTART COOLING PROCESS. USE THERMOMETER TO MONITOR COOLING TO ENSURE COOLING PARAMETERS ARE MET.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the MOP SINK FAUCET AND HAND WASH SINK FAUCET WITH HOSES WITH SPRAY NOZZLES CONNECTED TO THE water supply system.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE INSTALL APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICES FOR CONTINUOUS PRESSURE ON BOTH UNITS CONNECTED TO THE WATER SUPPLY SYSTEM.
